title: Priyanka Chopra Hasn't Made a Hindi Film in Seven Years. She's Still India's Third Most Valuable Star.
excerpt: Fortune India's inaugural celebrity ranking puts the diaspora queen at ₹2,507 crore — above Dhoni, Ranveer, and every other woman in the country. And with Rajamouli's Varanasi on the horizon, she's only getting started.
body:
Here's the thing about Priyanka Chopra Jonas that keeps confusing the industry spreadsheet warriors: she doesn't play by the rules they track.

Her last Hindi theatrical release was The Sky Is Pink, back in October 2019. Seven years ago. In Bollywood arithmetic, that's a career obituary. Actresses with far more recent hits have slid off the cultural map entirely. And yet, when Fortune India and Interbrand released their inaugural Most Valuable Celebrities ranking this week — the first rigorous attempt to quantify celebrity brand power in India using methodology that goes beyond box office and Instagram followers — Priyanka landed at number three.

Not third among women. Third overall. Behind only Virat Kohli (₹3,542 crore) and Shah Rukh Khan (₹3,017 crore). Ahead of MS Dhoni, Ranveer Singh, Akshay Kumar, Amitabh Bachchan, and every single one of her female contemporaries.

https://www.instagram.com/p/DZbozuNmxcC/

The Cover Says Everything

Fortune India printed three standalone covers for its June 2026 edition — Kohli, Akshay Kumar, and Priyanka. She's the only woman to receive a dedicated cover. The symbolism isn't subtle, and it isn't supposed to be.

The study evaluated 25 celebrities across six dimensions borrowed from Interbrand's global brand-valuation framework: distinctiveness, coherence, engagement, trust, intimacy, and responsibility. It's the same methodology used to value Apple and Nike, adapted for the first time to human brands in India. This isn't a popularity contest. It isn't a follower count. It's a measure of what a name is actually worth in the marketplace — and Priyanka's number is ₹2,507 crore.

"The study highlighted her growing international presence and ability to maintain relevance across markets." — Fortune India

What drives that valuation is something traditional Bollywood metrics miss entirely: Priyanka has built an ecosystem that doesn't depend on any single revenue stream. She's not just an actress anymore. She's a venture-backed entrepreneur, a producer, and one of the most sought-after brand ambassadors on the planet. Bvlgari made her a Global Ambassador in 2021. Bentley Motors followed in April 2026 — because apparently the luxury auto world decided it needed a face that resonates in Mumbai and Manhattan simultaneously.

The Diaspora Factor

For NRIs in the US, UK, and Canada, Priyanka's positioning isn't surprising — it's obvious. She's the rare Indian celebrity whose cultural footprint lives in both worlds equally. She headlined Citadel Season 2 on Prime Video last month, holding her own against Richard Madden in a $300 million Russo Brothers spy thriller that streams in over 240 countries. She walked the Met Gala. She produces content for both Hollywood and Indian audiences. Her social media reach spans continents.

But the ranking also speaks to something deeper about diaspora influence on brand value. Priyanka's audience isn't concentrated in one market — it's distributed globally, which makes her endorsement worth more per impression than stars who command attention only within India. The brands that partner with her — Bvlgari, Bentley, Max Factor — are selling to exactly the affluent, bicultural consumer that the diaspora represents.

And Then There's Varanasi

Here's what makes 2026 the setup for something even bigger: Priyanka is currently shooting S.S. Rajamouli's Varanasi, a ₹1,300 crore time-travel action epic that might be the most ambitious Indian film ever mounted. She plays Mandakini opposite Mahesh Babu's Rudhra, with Prithviraj Sukumaran rounding out the lead trio and M.M. Keeravani scoring the music. The production has already filmed across Africa and reportedly heads to Antarctica next. Worldwide theatrical release: April 7, 2027.

This isn't a Bollywood comeback. Priyanka never left. She was building something that doesn't need Bollywood to exist — and now she's returning to Indian cinema through the most spectacular door imaginable, on the arm of the director who made RRR a global phenomenon.

Where the Other Women Stand

The full Fortune India top 10: Kohli, SRK, Priyanka, Dhoni, Ranveer Singh, Akshay Kumar, Amitabh Bachchan, Sachin Tendulkar, Alia Bhatt (9th), and Allu Arjun (10th). Further down the top 25, Deepika Padukone, Rashmika Mandanna, Kriti Sanon, cricketer Smriti Mandhana, and Nayanthara all feature.

But Priyanka at number three — above six men and every single one of her female contemporaries — isn't just a ranking. It's a statement about what happens when an Indian woman decides she doesn't need permission from any single industry to define her worth.

Fortune India just put a number on what the diaspora already knew.
